description: Move a packing list draft to packed to shipped, or cancel it. Shipping records the carrier, the tracking number and the date, and freezes the list. A shipped list cannot be reopened or edited.

carrier.description: Who is carrying it, recorded when moving to shipped

date.description: The day the step happened, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

force.description: Ship even though lines are short, over-packed or not on the order. Default false, and the reasons come back either way

packing_list.description: The packing list id, e.g. PL-2026-0001, or the order reference when only one list carries it

status.description: The status to move to. draft to packed to shipped, or cancelled from either open status

tracking.description: The carrier's consignment or tracking number, recorded when moving to shipped

name: packing_list_status
title: Move a packing list on
